author: National Geographic
description:
This compilation episode of Inside the American Mob goes back to 1978 when law enforcement is at war with the mob. But the FBI has a real chance to strike when a new generation of agents enters the FBI, Italian Americans who grew up in the same neighborhoods as gangsters. One of those agents is Joe Pistone, AKA Donnie Brasco, who infiltrates a crime family for the first time in FBI history. Meanwhile, in Providence, police detective Steven O’Donnell seizes the opportunity to go undercover in the Patriarca crime family.
